demand: Cross-repository HTTP API operation changes represented by OpenAPI 3.0 and 3.1.
identitySummary: Registry service ID plus exact operationId; path and method remain a separate preview lane.
compatibilitySummary: A digest-pinned, network-denied oasdiff process determines compatibility.
evidenceRendering: Operation, source location, activation timing, coverage dependencies, and remedy.
limitations: Remote $ref targets are never fetched and force partial coverage.
Path-and-method identities are preview-only and never merge with operationId identities.
Compatibility is unknown when the pinned oasdiff invocation is unavailable or fails.
